articles.title: Help EFF Solve an Issue That's Bigger than Creepy Ads
articles.summary: Microsoft patches a staggering 167 vulns including a SharePoint zero-day and the delightfully named 'BlueHammer' Windows Defender flaw. When your Patch Tuesday looks like a phone book, maybe it's time to reconsider that 'security through obscurity' strategy.

articles.title: YellowKey Tool Bypasses Windows 11 BitLocker Using Only a USB Stick
articles.summary: Microsoft Exchange gets pwned again via CVE-2026-42897, a spoofing bug exploited through crafted emails. Because apparently the only thing more reliable than death and taxes is Exchange vulnerabilities being actively exploited in the wild.

articles.title: Anti-DDoS Firm Heaped Attacks on Brazilian ISPs
articles.summary: Canvas education platform gets ransomed by cybercriminals who defaced login pages nationwide, disrupting schools and colleges. Nothing says 'back to school' like having your homework held hostage by extortion gangs.

articles.title: Canvas Hack Aftermath: Owner Instructure Reaches Deal With Hacker Group
articles.summary: Foxconn factories get breached with files from Apple, Intel, Google, Dell, and NVIDIA allegedly stolen. When your supply chain attack hits the supply chain of literally everyone, that's what we call 'economies of scale' in cybercrime.

articles.title: On-Prem Microsoft Exchange Server CVE-2026-42897 Exploited via Crafted Email
articles.summary: OpenAI gets caught in TanStack npm supply chain chaos after malware-laced packages compromise two employee devices. Even the AI overlords aren't immune to good old-fashioned supply chain fuckery.

articles.title: Victory! End-to-End Encrypted RCS Comes to Apple and Android Chats
articles.summary: Instagram kills its end-to-end encryption feature after years of promising privacy by default. Meta's commitment to user privacy dies faster than a mayfly in a bug zapper.

articles.title: EFF Launches New Offline Campaign for Saudi Wikipedian Osama Khalid
articles.summary: Apple finally delivers end-to-end encrypted RCS for iPhone-Android chats in iOS 26.5. Only took them until 2026 to stop letting your messages fly naked through the digital ether.

articles.title: Cyber Pioneers Ponder Past as Prologue
articles.summary: EFF launches campaign for Saudi Wikipedian Osama Khalid, who started contributing to Wikipedia Arabic at age 12 and became a prolific blogger. Apparently editing Wikipedia while Saudi is still considered a radical act.

articles.title: Patch Tuesday, April 2026 Edition
articles.summary: Scattered Spider member 'Tylerb' pleads guilty to wire fraud and identity theft for SMS phishing attacks in 2022. Another script kiddie discovers that federal prison food is significantly worse than mom's cooking.

articles.title: /C O R R E C T I O N -- Fleet Device Management/
articles.summary: YellowKey tool bypasses Windows 11 BitLocker using just a USB stick, courtesy of researcher Nightmare-Eclipse. Because nothing says 'enterprise security' like getting owned by a thumb drive.
